semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Nippon Fusso India Pvt. Ltd. provides fluorine resin coatings and linings that are critical for enhancing the performance and reliability of semiconductor components.
summary: Nippon Fusso India Pvt. Ltd. specializes in fluorine resin coatings and linings, which are essential for providing chemical resistance and durability in semiconductor manufacturing processes. Their products are used to enhance the performance and reliability of semiconductor components, making them a valuable supplier in the semiconductor value chain.
capabilities: Chemical resistance solutions for semiconductor components

regional_presence.Japan: Operates in multiple locations including Osaka, Saitama, and Fukuoka, focusing on fluorine processing technologies.
regional_presence.South Korea: Presence focused on fluorine processing technologies.
